entries.reason: Same test (255): a RETURN that succeeds ends the task, so the arm where RESP is NORMAL is never executed.
XFRFUN sets only fail codes '1' to '4' (291, 968-970, 1017, 1103, 1890); '3' is never returned (see WHEN '3') and '4' is screened out by VA010, so no other value reaches the EVALUATE.

WHEN '3' (XFRFUN fail code from an SQLCODE other than +100 on a read or update): every XFRFUN path that sets '3' (968-970, 1014-1017) then ABENDs (519, 579, 488, 669, 747, 819, 890) or hands off to the storm-drain abend handler, whose own RETURN sets '2' (1889-1890); XFRFUN never returns '3' to BNK1TFN.
WHEN '4' (XFRFUN sets '4' only for an amount not greater than zero, 291): BNK1TFN rejects an amount of zero or less in VA010 before the LINK.
SUBPGM-SUCCESS is 'Y' or 'N' on return from XFRFUN; every 'N' arm of the EVALUATE at 586 ends in GO TO GCD999 except WHEN '3', which XFRFUN never returns.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY` tests the 88 on the flag value '2' (line 52), set by no statement: only `SET SEND-ERASE` and `SET SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` (185, 239, 340) write the flag.
The RESP test inside the `IF SEND-DATAONLY` block (745), which is never entered.
The RESP test inside the `IF SEND-DATAONLY` block (745), which is never entered.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` is reached only with the flag '3': '1' (SEND-ERASE) leaves SM010 after the first SEND MAP and '2' is never set (see 745), so the test is always true.

Unreachable under X54 (the harness gives a field of typed blanks length 0, IBM silent on <f>L): the "entirely spaces" tally arm needs AMTL above 0 with every byte a leading space, but a blank amount arrives with AMTL = 0 and is rejected earlier by the AMTL = ZERO guard (VA010). A real 3270 may send typed blanks with a length; not modelled.
